description: A technomagical mod for Better Than Adventure! 8.0.1.

mods.name: Signal Industries
mods.description: A stylized technomagical mod centered around a special power source, cool gadgets included.

releases.notes:
- Fixed crash that could happen when some machines consume their inputs.
- Log illegal attempts at inventory serialization.
- Prevent locked slots from being interacted with even more.

mods.name: Signal Industries
mods.description: A stylized technomagical mod centered around a special power source, cool gadgets included.

releases.notes:
- Fix issues with portable workbench.
- Added icons for SI armor to the hud armor bar.
- Power suit redesign.
- Wings now match the color of the suit. (except transparent, white)
- Storage containers now less awful.
- Performance improvements.
- Fixed slots being one pixel off in backpack GUI.
- Added the BTA! flowers, mushrooms, tall grass and ferns to the bonsai, and pumpkins to the greenhouse.
- Added rubyglass and sulfur to laser drills nether lootpool.
- Induction smelter can now process blast furnace recipes if it has an additional heating coil in its input bus.
- Buffed fluid conduit max transfer amount.
- Added the ability to pickup storage containers.
- Recipes now show chance.
- Updated the UI for the Signalite Reactor.
- Buffed chance of getting reality string from crushing rooted fabric.

releases.notes:
- Added interference mechanic to reinforced meteor tracker.
- Added unique textures for creative utilities.
- Added recipe for basic chainsaw casing.
- Fixed rendering of storage containers and multiparts on conduits on servers.
- Added the green suit colorizer.

mods.name: Signal Industries
mods.description: A stylized technomagical mod centered around a special power source, cool gadgets included.

releases.notes:
- Fix projectile ability being affected by gravity.
- Added a warning about deleting meteor sites to the meteor tracker quest.
- Added chainsaw.
- Added magnet.
- Added ability to swap conduits in-place by clicking them with another conduit in hand.
- Readded SI multiblocks and mobs to the BTA guidebook.
- Fluid tanks can now be interacted with by clicking on them with a bucket or any other fluid containing item.
- Tools now properly display their charge in the "durability" bar.
- Add some balance configurations to config and a command to see it.
- Made status messages actually show up as status messages and not spam the chat.
- No longer need filled buckets for basic pump recipe.
- Buffed some conduit recipes.
- Improved wrath beacon challenge.
